timing_scope: input loading, cached evaluation and self-check; before artifact writes

selection.rule: min(mean_judged, threshold) subject to strict_correct >= 0.95 * full-K; margin < threshold
selection.endpoint: nextafter(max finite development margin, +inf); fewer than 2 candidates do not trigger

self_check.message: K=20 self-check PASS (GPT-6 confirmation stage1_judge, all pairwise/list metrics): strict=311/371, both=129, pref@1=0.6495956873315364

cost_definition: available selected query/candidate cache scores / all role queries; includes available entries in whole-query fallbacks; no new calls
missing_definition: selected top-K entries absent or unavailable; whole-query stage1 fallback
route_definition: routes.dense/sparse/bm25 minimum zero-based rank chunk_id; any absent/empty route or absent query triggers and is counted
